# The per-layout spec tables in src/spec_*.cpp (plus spec_generated.h) are
# generated by
# tools/codegen; scripts/build.sh runs the generator before CMake configure.

set(KHIPRO_CORE_SOURCES
  src/spec_classic.cpp
  src/spec_classic_touch.cpp
  src/spec_dark.cpp
  src/spec_dark_touch.cpp
  src/spec_pod.cpp
  src/engine.cpp
  src/convert.cpp
  src/api.cpp
)

function(khipro_apply_target_flags target_name)
  target_include_directories(${target_name}
    PUBLIC
      $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
      $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
    PRIVATE
      ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
  )
  target_compile_options(${target_name} PRIVATE
    -Os
    -ffunction-sections
    -fdata-sections
    -fvisibility=hidden
    -fvisibility-inlines-hidden
  )
  if(APPLE)
    target_link_options(${target_name} PRIVATE -Wl,-dead_strip)  # ld64 has no --gc-sections
  elseif(NOT MSVC)
    target_link_options(${target_name} PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections)
  endif()
  if(WIN32 AND NOT MSVC)
    # Ship a self-contained DLL: end users don't have libstdc++-6.dll,
    # libgcc_s_seh-1.dll, or libwinpthread-1.dll, so the C++ runtime must be
    # baked in. -static covers winpthread; the gcc/stdc++ flags are explicit.
    target_link_options(${target_name} PRIVATE -static -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc)
  endif()
endfunction()

if(KHIPRO_BUILD_SHARED)
  add_library(khipro_shared SHARED ${KHIPRO_CORE_SOURCES})
  add_library(khipro::shared ALIAS khipro_shared)
  set_target_properties(khipro_shared PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME khipro
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
  )
  # MinGW would name the DLL "libkhipro.dll" while staging and every doc
  # promise "khipro.dll" — and the import lib embeds the DLL name it was
  # built against, so a renamed DLL breaks dynamic consumers at load time.
  # Drop the prefix on Windows so DLL and import lib agree on khipro.dll.
  if(WIN32 AND NOT MSVC)
    set_target_properties(khipro_shared PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
  endif()
  target_compile_definitions(khipro_shared PRIVATE KHIPRO_BUILD_SHARED)
  if(MSVC)
    target_sources(khipro_shared PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/khipro.def")
  endif()
  khipro_apply_target_flags(khipro_shared)
endif()

if(KHIPRO_BUILD_STATIC)
  add_library(khipro_static STATIC ${KHIPRO_CORE_SOURCES})
  add_library(khipro::static ALIAS khipro_static)
  set_target_properties(khipro_static PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME khipro)
  khipro_apply_target_flags(khipro_static)
  # The static archive carries C++ object code, so consumers must link the
  # GCC C++ runtime. Inject the static-runtime flags into the exported target
  # so find_package(khipro) consumers get them without knowing about this.
  if(WIN32 AND NOT MSVC)
    # -static covers libgcc, libstdc++ and winpthread in one flag, making
    # consumer executables self-contained with zero extra link flags.
    set_property(TARGET khipro_static PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_OPTIONS
      "-static")
  endif()
endif()

add_library(khipro ALIAS khipro_static)

include(GNUInstallDirs)

install(FILES include/khipro/khipro.h DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/khipro)

if(KHIPRO_BUILD_SHARED)
  install(TARGETS khipro_shared
    EXPORT khiproTargets
    LIBRARY DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
  )
endif()

if(KHIPRO_BUILD_STATIC)
  install(TARGETS khipro_static
    EXPORT khiproTargets
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}
  )
endif()

install(EXPORT khiproTargets
  FILE khiproTargets.cmake
  NAMESPACE khipro::
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/khipro
)
# Build-tree copy: the dist staging step packages this alongside the libs.
export(EXPORT khiproTargets
  FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/khiproTargets.cmake"
  NAMESPACE khipro::
)

include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
configure_package_config_file(
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/khiproConfig.cmake.in"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/khiproConfig.cmake"
  INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/khipro
)
write_basic_package_version_file(
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/khiproConfigVersion.cmake"
  VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
  COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion
)
install(FILES
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/khiproConfig.cmake"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/khiproConfigVersion.cmake"
  DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/khipro
)

# MinGW static consumers need the GCC runtime flags; pkg-config injects
# them via Libs.private so `pkg-config --libs khipro` just works.
if(WIN32 AND NOT MSVC)
  set(KHIPRO_PC_LIBS_PRIVATE "-static")
else()
  set(KHIPRO_PC_LIBS_PRIVATE "")
endif()

configure_file(
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/khipro.pc.in"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/khipro.pc"
  @ONLY
)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/khipro.pc" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig)
